row.evidence: Square's help centre says "You can add, edit, and deactivate team members from Square Dashboard or the Square Team app"; no Square pricing, help or developer page documents SCIM, and Okta's Square app checks OIDC only.
row.notes: No SCIM by absence (pricing page, US sitemap, help-centre search API, developer llms.txt and Team API reference searched). Plans are per location: Square Free $0, Plus $49, Premium $149 per location per month; Square Pro custom. A new Okta OIN app (Aug 2026) offers OIDC SSO to Dashboard and POS, but Square does not document it, so sso_plan is null. The Team API can create, search, update and deactivate team members (EMPLOYEES_READ/WRITE scopes) with team_member webhooks; permissions and passcodes are Dashboard-only.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented on Square's help centre, pricing page or developer docs. Okta's OIN app (updated Aug 2026) checks OIDC only, with no SCIM or provisioning capabilities.

endpoints.purpose: Update team member, including status ACTIVE/INACTIVE

limitations.text: Permissions and passcodes cannot be set through the Team API.

user_api.notes: Square Team API manages team members, jobs and wage settings; permissions and passcodes must still be set in Square Dashboard.

okta.notes: OIN app is OIDC SSO for Square Dashboard and POS; its description mentions provisioning, but no provisioning capability is checked.

conflicts.text: Okta's OIN description says the Square integration can 'provision employee accounts', but the same page checks only OIDC and no SCIM or provisioning capabilities; Square's own pages do not document SSO or provisioning.

searched: https://squareup.com/us/en/sitemap.xml.gz (2,033 URLs; no sso, saml, scim or okta pages)
Square help-centre search API (/api/v1/bookshelf/search): okta, single sign-on, scim, SSO, identity provider
https://developer.squareup.com/llms.txt (no scim, saml, okta or single sign-on)
open_questions: Square's own docs do not describe the Okta OIDC sign-in integration, which plans include it, or whether it creates team members (JIT).
Whether the Team API is limited by Square plan is not stated.
The Square Dashboard Activity Log (Advanced Access) has no documented API.
